title: Module source and class factors after scalar forgetting
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring in Type(u+1), W and S schemes in universe u, k:W→S a scheme morphism, G an etale module sheaf on W with coefficients Λ, q a natural number, U an object of S.Etale, A and B objects of Over(W), f:A→B a morphism, and z an element of the module raw derived Hom group at B for (Λ,k,G,q,U). Using the concrete prefix of def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-source-prefix, evaluating rawModuleAbelianHomMap at A on the module raw pullback of z equals rawModuleScalarSourcePrefix followed by the inverse derived scalar pullback comparison at the shifted B module coefficient, the derived forgotten moduleCoefficientFactor, and scalarCoefficientFactor at A. The coefficient tail is left in its module form. No abelian raw pullback or coefficient coherence equation occurs.

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 03Q8; source, class and coefficient factor calculation of lem-sbc-raw-module-abelian-hom-map-naturality

proof.text: Expand the additive scalar map and module raw pullback into the scalar source factor and three separately forgotten factors using rawModuleScalar_hom_composite_formula.

Apply rawModuleScalar_source_class_formula to the first three factors. Postcompose its equality with the forgotten module coefficient and scalar coefficient factors using congrArg. Combine the expansion with this equality by transitivity and Category.assoc.

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleAbelianHomMap_source_formula
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op B)) :
    rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A
      ((higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).map f.op z) =
    rawModuleScalarSourcePrefix Λ k G q U A B f z ≫
      ((RawModuleScalarComparison.derivedPullbackIso Λ f.left).inv.app
          (((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) B.hom).obj G))⟦(q : ℤ)⟧) ≫
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          (moduleCoefficientFactor Λ G (q : ℤ) A B f) ≫
        scalarCoefficientFactor Λ A.hom G (q : ℤ))
